meta.note: Rebuilt economy. Purchase values are FULL price (discount removed). Coins are BASE values (x1.2 / x2 multipliers ignored). Missing floors are omitted and will be generated later on request.

formulas.balanceRule: From floor 3 onward both purchase and coins are fixed ratios of delivery time. purchase = delivery * [1/6, 0.26667, 0.48333]; coins = delivery * [0.26667, 0.35167, 0.53167]. Floors 1-2 are hand-tuned for early game.
formulas.exception: Floor 1 slot 1 is a deliberately weakened starter product (rate 0.152)

exactRates.note: slot3 delivery is always divisible by 600; generated floors follow this
